suite: Portable embedding math and independent tiny encoder correctness
notes: Hardware intrinsics disabled for the entire test process; tests exercise portable score/value kernels, online softmax, pooling and long/mixed full-encoder scalar oracles.
Four ARM packed-Q8 cases return early when their required ISA is unavailable. This run does not validate those ARM kernels or claim x86 hardware performance.

Nine online-softmax double-oracle cases cover key lengths1/63/64/65/127/128/129/1025, query counts1/3/4/7/63/64, heads8/32/64 onARM, changing running maxima, unaligned starts and output/scratch canaries. These exercise long-only4query×16output register kernels and64query×128key tiles.
Seven fused subtract/Vector.Exp/sum cases verify scalar accuracy and unaligned/tail buffer safety. No approximate exponential or reduced-precision attention was added.
